not_a_reading: A bounded re-reading of already cataloged HABS sheet 4 to expose disagreements, not a new survey or an independent historical source.
locator: HABS IL-1015 sheet 4, Section A-A, 1963; sheet 2 printed 74-ft Prairie length supplies the horizontal scale.
coordinate_rule: Coordinates below refer to the complete sheet uniformly resized to 1791 × 1408 for manual inspection; multiply x by 9648/1791 and y by 7584/1408 for the source raster. No crop, perspective rectification or camera fit.

calibration.why: Outer wall planes on section, not finials/chimney edges; scale transferred from the drawn plan length. Section is not a photogrammetric roof plan.

uncertainty: Manual line choice approximately ±3 canvas px per endpoint; architectural/datum correspondence and scan scale dominate. Treat positions and roof rise as approximately ±1 ft; small hood dimensions approximately ±0.6 ft. These are review bounds, not statistical confidence intervals. The horizontal plan scale is also applied vertically; the section supplies no independent printed vertical control in this reading. Nonuniform scan/drawing scale and host-versus-ornament line choice remain unresolved.

readings.control: first dormer hood rise excluding finial
stair turret cone rise excluding finial
stair turret eave to finial tip
north tower cone rise excluding finial
north tower eave to finial tip

decision: Retain sheet-6-controlled main ridge. Sheet 4 suggests approximately 17 ft rise above its courtyard eave, versus 19.94 ft from the model combined with the reconstructed door-to-grade transfer. This exceeds the review bound and remains an unresolved cross-sheet disagreement, not permission to shorten the roof. Dormer silhouette/position differences require independently reconciled controls before correction. The stair turret likewise gives about 7.54 ft of cone rise (9.80 ft in the model), or 9.20 ft to the finial tip (11.80 ft in the model). This approximately 2–3-ft disagreement is recorded alongside the main ridge, rather than independently shortening one connected silhouette. The north cone is closer, about 10.32 ft versus 11.00 ft. Resolve roof-apex versus finial-tip definitions and a common datum before a corrective rebuild.
phase_limit: 1963 retained fabric; 1904 carryback remains inferred. No source pixels redistributed by this audit.
